title: Conversation Record
description: A conversation record capturing derived conversation signals, including a topic hierarchy classification. Record-based (time-invariant) so it can be composed into a schema and used as a lookup/reference dataset.

xdm:topic.title: Topic
xdm:topic.description: Topic classification derived for the conversation.

xdm:hierarchy.title: Topic Hierarchy
xdm:hierarchy.description: Denormalized topic taxonomy levels, from the top-level (level1) root down to the deepest level.

xdm:level1.title: Topic Level 1 (Root)
xdm:level1.description: The highest-level (root) parent topic in the hierarchy.

xdm:level2.title: Topic Level 2
xdm:level2.description: The second-level topic, a child of level1.

xdm:level3.title: Topic Level 3 (Deepest)
xdm:level3.description: The third-level (deepest) topic, a child of level2.
